free_tier.stated: no free plan: a free trial of up to 30 days with no card, capped at 120 sent messages per day; the cheapest plan with custom domains and IMAP is Individual at $5 per month, billed as $60 for 12 months
free_tier.notes: Individual is $6 month to month, $114 for 24 months or $168 for 36 months. Duo is $96 for 12 months for two users and Family $132 for 12 months for up to six. Basic ($36 for 12 months, 6 GB) allows no custom domains and includes no IMAP or SMTP.

per_object_cap.stated: 70 MB per message sent or received, which usually means an attachment of no more than 50 MB

retention.stated: 50 GB for mail, calendar and contacts plus 10 GB of file storage on Individual; mail over quota is soft-bounced, then hard-bounced after a week; an unpaid trial loses sending and receiving, then is disabled and deleted

egress.terms: not applicable: a mailbox; sending is capped at 8,000 messages and 2 GB per day per user on Individual, and at 120 messages per day on a trial
egress.free_allowance: 120 sent messages per day on a trial account

interface_detail: IMAP at imap.fastmail.com (993), POP at pop.fastmail.com and SMTP at smtp.fastmail.com (465, or 587 with STARTTLS), all with an app password and TLS only; WebDAV file access at https://webdav.fastmail.com/; CalDAV and CardDAV. Basic plans include no IMAP, SMTP, CalDAV or CardDAV
tooling: any IMAP, POP or SMTP client with an app password; any WebDAV client for files
chaining: a full mailbox with custom domains, IMAP, WebDAV files and 8,000 sends per day at $60 a year; the price buys 50 GB and send volume rather than a low entry cost.

limits.value: 8,000 messages and 2 GB sent per day per user on Individual; the hourly limit is half the daily and the 10-minute limit half the hourly
120 messages sent per day on a trial account
50 GB of mail storage and 10 GB of file storage per user on Individual
a trial user not verified by SMS cannot download mail over IMAP or POP

binding_note: on a trial the 120 messages per day bind first; on Individual the 8,000 per day is the first stated ceiling, and storage of 50 GB rarely binds before it.

identity_cost.detail: the trial asks for a name, a new address on a Fastmail domain or an own domain, and a password, with no card, and may ask for a mobile phone number for an SMS code; a trial user not verified by SMS cannot read mail over IMAP or POP. The paid plan accepts credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and no cash or bank transfer.

reliability_note: accounts found sending duplicative email are closed permanently; an unpaid trial loses sending and receiving, then is disabled and deleted
confidence_note: prices and limits read from the vendor pages; imap.fastmail.com:993 accepted a TCP connection and smtp.fastmail.com:587 answered with an ESMTP banner; no login or send was made
